title: Add simple fixed-wait retry
body: Added a simple fixed-wait retry of 1 second on failed HTTP requests. I also retry health checks so flaky nodes can recover. A fixed wait keeps the code easy to read.

title: Use exponential backoff for retries
body: We should wait longer after each failed try, starting at half a second and doubling each time. This spreads out retry attempts naturally so recovered services have breathing room.

title: Document retry settings
body: Documented the retry settings in the README. No code changes.

title: Do not retry health checks
body: Health checks should fail fast rather than retrying so unhealthy nodes leave the pool immediately. This reverses part of the earlier health check retry.

title: Move retry module to src/net
body: Moved the retry module to src/net so networking code lives together. No behavior changes.

title: Cap total retry wait
body: Caps backoff at 10 seconds total across all attempts so requests do not hang indefinitely.
